description: Add (or remove, if remove=true) a wall segment starting at (x,y) running in octant `direction` for `length` tiles on `level`. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side gate via VMTSOLotState.OwnerID; server-side also refuses if < BuildBuyRoommate via Validator.CanBuildTool). Effect: wall appears (or disappears) — observable via query-architecture at the affected tiles; perception does not expose walls. Cost: wall materials are debited from lot funds by the server during Architecture.RunCommands (indirect — not a direct GlobalLink transaction). Denial is a silent drop with no error PDU back (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: WALL_LINE | WALL_DELETE, level, x, y, x2=length, y2=direction, pattern, style }] } on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF place-wall --x <tile_x> --y <tile_y> --length <tiles> --direction <0..7>                       # build a wall (tile coords, not subtile!)
cf $CF place-wall --x <x> --y <y> --length <n> --direction <d> --remove true                         # delete existing wall along same line

cf $CF place-wall --x --y --length --direction --pattern

--style --level 2 # with wallpaper + upper floor
common_mistakes: x/y are TILE coords (not subtile!) for architecture ops — don't multiply by 16 here.
direction is an octant 0..7: 0=E, 2=S, 4=W, 6=N, odd values are diagonals.
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
